text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: More, more, even more...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhhh—!

Midway through summer camp. While everyone was forging
mind and body for their next races—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

Mihono Bourbon was also training hard
to overcome the 3000m barrier of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo...
choice_data_list: Want to take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No...!
My remaining stamina is not an issue.

Mihono Bourbon put on
a magnificent display of running at the Japan Derby.
She was supposed to be tackling the Kikuka Sho with a positive mindset, but for some reason, she hadn't been in good form lately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...My time dropped again compared to yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The slump has continued from yesterday and the day before.
I attempted analysis, but the cause remains unknown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I find no issues with the training flowchart either.

"Even so, the sun is setting.
We can't stay on the beach forever."

Urging a bewildered Mihono Bourbon along,
we returned to the training camp lodge. That night—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master. I have something to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Increasing anxiety, restlessness, accumulated fatigue...
I looked up various symptoms in specialized medical books and—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Taking all factors into account, my current status
has transitioned to 'Timid.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because of that, there is data that keeps replaying in my mind during training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Before my debut, despite undergoing rigorous training, my times became heavily disrupted during a 3000m run. Here is the data from that day.

Previously, in order to convince her former Trainer,
who wanted to develop her as a sprinter—
There was a time when I ran 3,000m and failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With the strength I had back then, it was a natural outcome.
I fully "accept" this result.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yet, completely illogically, that chilling sensation in my stomach from that day has been replaying over and over for the past few days.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Nothing like that has ever happened before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, now, not only do the memories repeat on their own—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The default method implemented for
conducting training calmly has vanished.
A weakened Mihono Bourbon, unlike anything seen before.
At any rate, it seemed like a change of pace was needed right away. And so—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...
The mountains are pleasantly cool, aren't they, Master?
"Indeed, whether it was because of the nearby stream or being up in the mountains, there was a refreshing coolness in the air."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Lactic acid generation suppressed via negative ions.
Thiamine consumption currently decreasing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Due to mental and physical stability, 'Relaxed' status confirmed.
Acquired method for mood refreshing via mountain climbing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the proposal, Master.
I shall put it to good use in our future training.
choice_data_list: I'm glad if that helped you refresh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master frequently provides me with
various information not found in my data logs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For example, the factor that enabled me to run 1600m
with consistent lap times was inputting Master's advice.

Now that you mention it, something like that happened
back when we first met.

Unable to watch such reckless training methods any longer,
I suggested a running routine focused on lap times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Transition to status: 'Joy' confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your effective advice, I'm one step closer
to achieving the Triple Crown. I'm truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master placed their "trust" in me
and implemented an effective update.

To tell the truth,
back then, I thought long distances would be difficult for her.

"I advised her to be conscious of her lap times
because I couldn't bear watching her push herself too far."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master?
choice_data_list: ...I actually thought we should've stuck to sprints.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
......
Status: "Shock" confirmed.

"When we first met, Mihono Bourbon was already
known as a promising talent in the sprint division."

With a powerful physique blessed with well-developed fast-twitch muscles,
she was, in fact, better suited for shorter distances.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, there is a contradiction in that.
Why did you scout me then?
choice_data_list: You're the one who made me believe.
Because you taught me to believe.

text_block_list.text:
Watching her try so hard, before I knew it,
I found myself wanting to believe in her.
Little by little, my memories began to return.

The day she ran 2000m to take 1st place,
and convinced the world she belonged on the Classic Triple Crown path—
Mihono Bourbon brilliantly turned what everyone thought was a pipe dream into reality.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is...
because Master's guidance was right on the mark.
choice_data_list: No, it's the result of your own hard work.
No, it's the result of your own hard work.

text_block_list.text: The hard work Mihono Bourbon has accumulated possesses the power to make anyone believe in her.
So surely, the upcoming Kikuka Sho will also—
choice_data_list: I believe you can run it all the way to the finish.
I believe you can run all the way through.

text_block_list.text: Saying that, Mihono Bourbon looked at me, seemingly in shock.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Master... believes in me.
――Eventually, we reached the summit.
The vast expanse of the setting sun wraps gently around Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Data recovery confirmed.
New "self-awareness" generated.

—And Mihono Bourbon lifted her downcast head,
looking straight forward with resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Up until now... I was aiming for the Classic Triple Crown
with true "determination," wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is a resolve I decided on when I was little.
One that is strong and unwavering—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Above all else,
it is something truly worthy of Master's trust.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I will... have confidence and challenge
the Kikuka Sho using my usual methods."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I judge that to be the best course.
I will make sure to claim victory in the 3000m."

Perhaps it was the setting sun,
but her blue eyes blazed with a fierce, red glow.
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status transitioned from 『Timid』 to 『Aggressive』.
I am capable of performing any training today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I await your orders, Master.

I want to properly live up to that enthusiasm.
With that in mind—
choice_data_list: Muscle training to the absolute limit
Beach running to the absolute limit

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received.
Initiating muscle training on Hard Mode.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *phew*...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Lactic acid buildup confirmed.
However, this is not the limit yet...!

We devoted ourselves to solid training
until the sun went down!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received.
Initiating beach run on Hard Mode.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Running alongside the sea offers beautiful scenery,
and I have discovered that it is 'fun.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For some reason,
I hadn't realized that until now.

We devoted ourselves to solid training
until the sun went down!
